meta.subtitle: Monthly performance review — Actuals vs LY, AOP and Blume Model
meta.modelBasis: Growth Huddle Model FY26; monthly model shown as annual / 12

calls.guidance: RAISED dividend by 4% to $0.27 per share; AUTHORIZED additional $100 billion share repurchase; June quarter revenue guidance 14-17% YoY growth; gross margin guidance 47.5-48.5%.
calls.growthDrivers: iPhone 17 family (22% YoY growth to $57B), Services all-time record (16% growth to $31B), MacBook Neo driving Mac growth (6% to $8.4B), and Apple Intelligence integration across platforms.
calls.headwinds: Supply constraints on iPhone and Mac from advanced node SoC availability; significantly higher memory costs in June quarter with increasing impact beyond; reduced supply chain flexibility; tariff-related costs impacting margins.

calls.guidance: MAINTAINED gross margin guidance at 48% to 49% for March quarter; MAINTAINED services revenue growth similar to December quarter; MAINTAINED operating expenses guidance at $18.4 billion to $18.7 billion.
calls.growthDrivers: iPhone revenue growth of 23% YoY driven by iPhone 17 lineup; Services revenue growth of 14% YoY with all-time records in advertising, music, payment services and cloud services; Strong performance in emerging markets including India with double-digit growth; Greater China growth of 38% YoY driven by iPhone.
calls.headwinds: Supply constraints on advanced nodes (3-nanometer) limiting iPhone production in Q2; Memory pricing increases expected to impact Q2 gross margin; Wearables category experienced constraints on AirPods Pro 3; Less flexibility in supply chain due to high demand outstripping internal estimates.

calls.guidance: The company MAINTAINED full-year 2026 guidance issued in February, citing Q1 as the lowest seasonal quarter with much of the year remaining.
calls.growthDrivers: Major growth drivers: (1) Fitness segment +42% led by advanced wearables with market share gains; (2) Aviation +18% from OEM and aftermarket; (3) Marine +11% across multiple categories; (4) APAC region +25% and EMEA +15% benefited from favorable FX.
calls.headwinds: Headwinds include: (1) higher tariff costs impacting Marine margins; (2) component cost pressures expected to intensify in 2027 as safety stock depletes; (3) geopolitical uncertainty affecting Marine and Aviation customer sentiment; (4) BMW auto OEM program declining as Mercedes ramp begins in 2027.

calls.guidance: INCREASED 2026 revenue guidance to $7.9B (+9% YoY), operating income to exceed $2B, and pro forma EPS to $9.35 (+9% YoY). LOWERED gross margin guidance to 58.5% (-20 bps) and operating margin to 25.5%.
calls.growthDrivers: Major drivers: (1) wearables market share gains and growth in Fitness (+33% YoY to $2.36B), (2) adventure watches in Outdoor (+5% to $2.05B), (3) OEM and aftermarket products in Aviation (+13% to $987M), (4) chartplotters in Marine (+10% to $1.18B), (5) domain controllers in Auto OEM (+9% to $665M).
calls.headwinds: Headwinds include: (1) generationally high tariff structures impacting costs, (2) memory component cost pressures, (3) higher product costs reducing gross margin by 20 bps in 2026, (4) Auto OEM revenue decline from peak BMW volumes and legacy program end-of-life.
